listening.title: Asking your team lead for three days off

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Hi Hoa, do you have a minute? I need to talk about some time off next week.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Sure, Nam. Have you already sent the leave request form to HR?

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Not yet. I wanted to check with you first, because it is three days in a row.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: That is fine. Which days are you planning to be on leave?

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Wednesday to Friday. My sister is getting married in Da Nang.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Congratulations. Who can stand in for you during the release check?

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Minh knows the payment module well. I will hand over my notes on Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Good. Please also set an auto-reply so the client knows you are away.

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: I will. And if there is an emergency, Minh can call me on my mobile.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Let's hope that is not needed. Send the form today and I will approve it this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Thank you, Hoa. I will be back at work on Monday morning.
